module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Single-clock FPGA wrapper that integrates firmware-visible MMIO, bounded host transport, response validation, deterministic command packing, and compact fault/status reporting. The top-level RTL acts as the real integration point and drives all declared top-level outputs directly from internal logic or child module outputs.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Firmware configures enable, arm, clear_faults, sequence IDs, timeout threshold, clamp bounds, and compact request metadata through the CSR/MMIO window. The top coordinates request issuance when enabled and armed, propagates transport and validation status, and inhibits command validity on reset, not-armed, invalid, stale, timeout, or fault conditions.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use a small set of explicit transaction and status registers for pending-request tracking, expected sequence, response age, latched fault summary, and last-seen sequence/fault code. Reset clears pending transaction state and initializes all status to deterministic values. Faults are latched until software clear is accepted under non-triggering conditions.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive host_req_valid and host_req_data from transport composition logic, accept host_rsp_valid/data at the transport boundary with host_rsp_ready driven by RTL, and drive aero_cmd_out/cmd_valid only when validation qualifies a response. fault_out is driven by the fault manager as a compact software-visible summary.
ownership_notes: ctrl_rdata and ctrl_ready are owned by the MMIO/register block.
host_req_valid and host_req_data are owned by transport logic.
host_rsp_ready is owned by transport logic and follows the transaction state.
aero_cmd_out and cmd_valid are owned by the command shaper.
fault_out and software-facing status are owned by the fault manager.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top_mmio
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact firmware-visible CSR/MMIO decode and readback block with a 64-bit register window and explicit field decode for every declared register.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept ctrl_valid/ctrl_write transactions, decode ctrl_addr, update writable control fields, and return readback data for both configuration and live status. Register writes directly populate semantic outputs for enable, arm, clear_faults, sequence selection, timeout threshold, clamp bounds, and compact request metadata.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Hold only the writable control state required for readback and downstream configuration. Read-only status fields are assembled from live inputs rather than stored as hidden software-visible state.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive ctrl_rdata and ctrl_ready continuously from decoded register state and live status. Provide semantic configuration outputs for transport, validation, and request composition.
ownership_notes: Implements the sole software-visible register bank described by register_contract.
Every declared register is reachable through RTL decode.
No inaccessible internal state is exposed as software-visible storage.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top_transport
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Bounded request/response transaction manager for a single outstanding host interaction at a time, with compact metadata packing and deterministic handshake behavior.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: When enabled and armed, form a compact host request frame from the request metadata fields, assert host_req_valid, and hold it until host_req_ready is observed or a local timeout aborts the transaction. The block qualifies inbound host_rsp_valid only when the transaction is active and the sequence expectation matches.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Track a small transaction state, expected sequence, last seen sequence, response age, request-issued indication, and latched transport fault summary. Use a bounded counter for age/timeout monitoring. Reset clears all transaction state and counters.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive host_req_valid and host_req_data as outputs, and drive host_rsp_ready as an RTL output that reflects whether a response is expected in the current transaction state. Provide tx_* status outputs for downstream validation and software logging.
ownership_notes: host_req_valid, host_req_data, and host_rsp_ready are real RTL-driven ports.
host_rsp_valid and host_rsp_data are consumed as inputs, not driven.
The request frame contains only compact metadata; no bulk payload or tensor data is carried.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top_validation
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Simple response qualification and safety-filter stage that checks transaction state, sequence match, response status, and age before allowing command formation.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept only responses that are transaction-aligned, sequence-matching, status-acceptable, and non-expired. Clamp the candidate output target to the configured min/max range. Reject invalid or stale responses without updating the downstream command path.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: This block is primarily combinational with minimal registered qualification if needed for timing closure. It does not maintain independent long-lived state beyond what is needed to produce explicit rejection indications.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce valid_response only when the response is accepted. Forward validated_target, validated_rate_limit, and validated_mode_bits to the command shaper. Drive explicit validation fault indicators for software observability.
ownership_notes: Does not substitute an alternate command on rejection.
Only qualifies or rejects the incoming response.
Validation outputs are consumed by the command shaper and fault manager.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top_command_shaper
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Deterministic actuator command packer that converts validated compact target, rate-limit, and mode information into a 32-bit packed command word.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: When valid_response is asserted, apply internal saturation to the validated target using the configured clamp bounds and pack the command fields into aero_cmd_out. If no valid response exists, deassert cmd_valid and hold the command output in an inhibited deterministic value.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Prefer purely combinational packing with optional one-stage registering only if needed for timing. No complex command sequencing FSM is required.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive aero_cmd_out, cmd_valid, and the saturated field mirrors cmd_target_sat, cmd_rate_limit_sat, and cmd_mode_bits_sat. The output remains deterministic and synthesis-friendly.
ownership_notes: No fallback or substitute command is generated.
Absence of a valid response only inhibits command validity.
The packed word supports target/deflection plus optional rate-limit and mode bits.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top_fault_manager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact fault aggregation and status encoding block that consolidates live transport/validation indicators and latched conditions for firmware logging and recovery.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Aggregate timeout, stale, invalid-response, not-armed, and related indicators into a deterministic fault summary. Support explicit clear_faults behavior while preserving reset determinism and non-silent recovery policy.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Latch fault status until software clear is accepted under safe conditions. Maintain last accepted sequence, last fault code, response age, and busy/valid-response indicators for readback.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive fault_out, fault_latched, and all software-visible status outputs. These outputs reflect system state; they do not directly alter transport or command behavior.
ownership_notes: Reports state only; does not directly drive transport or command control.
Provides firmware-visible summary for logging and recovery.
Reset clears latched status to deterministic values.

fsm_intent.description: A minimal explicit transaction state is implied for idle/request-pending/response-valid/fault-latched handling. No complex FSM is required beyond bounded request tracking and safe inhibit behavior.
A small bounded transport state machine is implied to manage a single outstanding request, hold valid until accepted, count age, and abort on timeout.
Validation is primarily combinational qualification with optional registered pulse generation; no standalone FSM is required.
Command shaping is deterministic packing and saturation; no standalone FSM is required.
Fault management is register-based aggregation and latch handling; no standalone FSM is required.

internal_storage: Writable control register bits for enable, arm, clear_faults, request_sequence, response_sequence, timeout_threshold, clamp_min, clamp_max, and compact request metadata.
output_mapping: ctrl_rdata readback assembled from config and live status
ctrl_ready indicates a simple ready/acknowledge response
Semantic outputs drive transport, validation, and request composition
host_req_valid asserts while request is pending
host_rsp_ready reflects whether a response is expected
tx_* outputs report transaction status and faults

internal_storage: Optional registered qualification pulse or acceptance flag if timing requires it
output_mapping: validated_rate_limit and validated_mode_bits pass through only when accepted

internal_storage: Optional registered packed command word for timing closure
output_mapping: aero_cmd_out is the packed actuator command word
cmd_valid is asserted only on accepted validated responses
cmd_target_sat, cmd_rate_limit_sat, cmd_mode_bits_sat expose saturated fields
fault_out encodes compact latched/live fault summary
status_* outputs provide software-readable logging and recovery context

sequencing_notes: Reset clears pending transactions, deasserts host_req_valid, deasserts cmd_valid, and initializes counters and status to deterministic values.
Software must program the MMIO window before arming request issuance.
When enabled and armed, the transport block composes a compact request frame and holds host_req_valid until host_req_ready is observed or timeout aborts the transaction.
Inbound responses are only accepted when the transaction is active and the expected sequence matches.
Validation must occur before command shaping; rejected responses do not update the actuator command path.
Faults remain latched until explicit clear_faults is written under safe conditions and the design is not in a fault-triggering active condition.
timing_notes: host_req_valid should be held with bounded combinational dependency on host_req_ready; registered state is preferred for handshake control.
host_rsp_ready should be derived from transaction state without creating an unbounded ready/valid combinational loop.
Age and timeout monitoring are bounded cycle counters.
Top-level output ports have real RTL drivers and are not connected only to child inputs.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
The design remains FPGA-targeted and synthesizable.
The external model transport direction contract is honored at the RTL boundary.
The firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface is real and decodes the declared registers.
Invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions inhibit cmd_valid rather than substituting a fallback command.
